name: Nine Violet
original_name: ナイン・ヴァイオレット
source:
Tesla's twin sister, who is quiet and unassuming. She is well-liked by some female students, possibly for her boyish appearance. Despite being expressionless, she is kind-hearted and enjoys spending time with the animals in the backyard. Like Tesla, she once served as an adversary as Twin Phantom, but she has since reconciled and become a friend.

After her transformation, she overwhelms her enemies with powerful attacks using her great sword.

[Translated from the [url=https://twin-angel-psp.com/character5.html]official site[/url]]
